documentation.content: A worker completion reported a dead job in the last 24 hours or a queued job older than 15 minutes. Inspect `paloma-data pipeline-status`; enqueue a reviewed replacement for dead work rather than editing queue state directly.

conditions.displayName: Worker reports dead or stale queued work

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="paloma-pipeline-worker" AND resource.labels.location="us-west1" AND jsonPayload.event="worker_finished" AND (jsonPayload.queue_metrics.jobs_dead_24h>0 OR jsonPayload.queue_metrics.oldest_queued_seconds>900)
